title: A synchronized heat-kernel construction on eight-dimensional hyperkähler products

status_qualification: All questions in this canonical excerpt are retained; the product heat-kernel construction suggested by its title is only a possible subcase. The extracted background remarks spill into separate subsequent massless-monopole, Singer and wave-trace questions; these are not silently reassigned to this canonical Cherkis/Mazzeo/Lee excerpt.
